`systeminformation/` is the unmodified npm package **systeminformation 5.33.19**
(https://github.com/sebhildebrandt/systeminformation), bundled with the native mod
so installing Devkits also installs its hardware dependency without a global npm
installation or a runtime download. Its original `LICENSE` and package metadata
are included.
